name: rubric
title: Rubric / Self-assessment
description: RF-10 criterion-by-criterion self-assessment with accessible single-select performance levels. Supports controlled/uncontrolled selection maps, disabled criteria, localized functional fallbacks, partial streaming levels and explicit empty/pending states. Reports textual assessment progress but deliberately exposes no score, answer key, weighting, correctness, pass/fail result or automatic grading path.
